title: What the Figure Does Not Know

arc.title: The Cold Stone
arc.subtitle: a warm stone, already going cold

epigraph.text: Six readings stand behind one figure and do not know one another. The figure was never asked what it read over, and the space where the price should stand has kept its silence.
epigraph.attribution: A saying of the Cross, told at the going of Bone

pov: Daniel Marchetti (Corin), close third-person past tense inside a body of three hundred and twenty-seven to three hundred and twenty-nine days, six months and one hundred and forty-seven to one hundred and forty-nine days, carried everywhere in a basket and told by nobody. No present-tense break and no tagged memory; the old life is carried by the surgeon's register alone, never a break in the narration. That register takes the body in its old order each morning — the stiff leathery brown-edged barley crust two inches from the ear with its corner standing a hair off the wool, its empty place unnamed and no third; the thread of drool frozen in the dry kiln heat and unwiped, because nobody under any roof has ever been given an instruction about the thread; cold stopped at cheek, temple and the bare wrist-joint where the wool rides back, as at the end of a line written out for it; the afterdrop waiting past a warming nobody here will perform — and reads the world as a trauma bay is read, by the small sounds first because the small sounds do not lie. He knows a cold patient cannot clot and will seem better before he is worse, and that the composed face is not composure; he knows the infant's want of the crust and the wiped thread is louder than the surgeon's knowing, and neither wins, and the argument is the work. Three counts in three places that do not become one, since agreeing any two would want a payer put under both and none stands: the carried fire's four low pulls with its fifth unpaid and its payer unnamed; the boards' four nails, four and a thumb-width knot; the river's water over water, a low thing over a lower thing, not numbered among the hearings. Six hearings of the full note stand beside and never among with the seventh place empty, the sixth the small flat knock out of a woman as the men lifted her, filed where a thing out of a person must go; the heard bell stays in its square beside the told bell of the Long Night; the told figure beside the paid. Five arithmetics of the year ride locked in Berr's box with one in twelve printed and unchallenged, the figure read still not the figure paid, no signature on the space, five readings five and not one account; on Bone 30 the third reading of Bone makes six, six readings six and not one account, and the finding is kept on a place of its own with no payer.
places: the flat stone by the well

scenes.title: The Twenty-Eighth Morning
scenes.synopsis: First of six entries, the chapter's only \dropcap and its first \daymark{327}{Bone 28, Eighthday, Y.H. 813}: the small hours under the Vail kiln-house roof into the first light of an ordinary Eighthday with no market, Cross or bell. Open on the hand laid down against the fold on answer 228 as a tool put away where the next hand will find it without looking; do not recap Chapter 91. Carry 326 to 327 exact, six months and 147 days told by nobody (T071/T072); the carried fire's fifth unpaid 327 days with its payer unnamed (T088); Garl's name unspoken the same number (T009/T013/T092). Nothing from Bone 27 crosses as sign, lesson, mending, cause or payment, and the thumb's resting on the seventh notch is not made again. Body inventory in the surgeon's old order: the stiff brown-edged crust two inches from the ear with its empty place unnamed and no third; the thread frozen and unwiped; cold at cheek, temple and the bare wrist-joint as at the end of a written line; the afterdrop beyond a warming nobody here will perform. He knows the composed face is not composure, that a cold patient cannot clot and must be warmed from outside and slowly, never rubbed, never set too near the fire; he wants the crust lifted two inches, the thread wiped and a hand on the pot handle. Both true, the second louder, the argument the work (T060/T086). Sella goes to the fire before the basket, tells the coals it is the thaw, turns them with the back of a broken pot, says The house will keep it where another woman would say I, counts a small intake, a hold and a letting-go toward no opening with neither gap figured, keeps her finger on top of the loaf shelf so the charcoal tally stays unread, moves her lips along a two-gapped row unfigured, glances once at the clay jar cold under lead glaze with the hand half over nothing and the little-door burn closing on air, lifts the twice-mended pot with the thumb first where the wire crosses the crack and says both proverbs to the pot and the fire with the crack showing, turns the dressed grain beneath the wool with the lighter touch and no figure and lifts no handful, sets the pot rim two inches beyond the reaching hand with a half-beat and no look toward the bed, and touches the widow's mark at no hour because a morning and a hearth are not openings (T058/T079/T100, T077). Three counts in three places that do not become one; six hearings beside and never among with the seventh place empty; heard bell in its square beside the told bell; told figure beside the paid. File open on the towel with every gap gap; the staying, the early letting-go, the handful and the thumb's resting four objects on four places with a finger between every pair and none made again; four held changes on four places and not a rule. Five arithmetics ride locked in Berr's box, one in twelve unchallenged, figure read not figure paid, no signature, five readings five and not one account, finding on a place of its own with no payer and not laid across the not-doings, covered grain, held changes, handful, thumb's resting, two small objects or his gaps — edges nearly touch, finger goes between (T015/T041/T047). Bone 30 (Day 329) two mornings ahead and not brought in. Answer 229: hand up an inch toward the river's note, small intake from the room whose floor does not touch his, interval held whole, let go on the same low note, straight down as a tool put away; the note had done before the hand came down, so neither early again nor stayed, borrowing no house count and supplying no payer (T061/T082).

scenes.title: The Month's Last Tend Goes Around
scenes.synopsis: Second entry of Day 327, no new dated heading: afternoon through the going of the light and into the small hours at the Clay Yard, rack end, yard well and flat stone, worked strips, kindling, flagstones, wheel-shed edge and damper, back room from outside, bed, boards and towel. Present: Corin/Dan, Sella, Tarn, Jorra; walk-ons (Cold Acre hare-carrier, man with cracked jar in rope sling); Garl in objects; no Ilva, no market, no Cross, no bell. Sella carries him down at the half-pace from every open slate, gives the instruction to the wool and the river wind and never to the basket, and goes wide around the seven walked-around places with a look and a wide step and no number: the clean dark line at the Vail corner and the finer grey hairline beside it called the thaw, unswept both; the space beneath the lowest rack where the broken birth-slates lie; the round ring where the shallow clay pan once stood with no scrape, crumb, print, chip or word; the trough's skin of ice; the field's empty place out on the worked strips; and the returning-line place where a hand went in on Seed 15 and did not come out — no eighth likeness, no cause across two, no payer (T009/T013/T092, T098 carried). Three coverings stay weather entered nowhere with a finger between every pair: the frost gone off the well's north lip on Bone 3 while the yard looked elsewhere (not a sign), the skin on the trough breaking and closing under a pail's knock, and the silt-clouded plate of ice on the flat stone out of the path of feet (T083/T085 held). Hunts and repairs stay directions judged by the carrying arm and the weather, never figures: the Cold Acre hare answered with the weather and gone toward the clay road with nobody weighing it or opening a slate; the cracked jar in a rope sling answered with the pot, and the pot says nothing; the boy reads both as a chart left blank where the number should stand and enters neither (T077). At the rack end the dressed grain lies turned under wool and given no figure; her fingers go in and come out without closing, no handful lifted, the empty fingers a keeping beside the one object and not a second (T077 held). Tarn at the kindling keeps six where the house can check and the seventh at the lip beside Garl's unforged collector sentence, the small knife at the edge of its sill where it can be checked and slip; says Six counted. The next I don't count; brings the ear-sentence to the word that would call the loan and stops as a remembered ninth stopping with no tenth before the seventh year at its very end; Seed 16 breath unspent, chest tight since the dark, Ash in the knuckle creases in the colour of the clean dark line, pale clip-ring holding light, stroke over the shallow bright patch without the half-check, warm loft stone cold in its unmarked pot and unreconciled by not trying, which is not forgiveness. The thumb's resting on the uncut seventh on Bone 26 is checked as one object on its own place and is not made again on Bone 28: not a tenth stopping, not the seventh year given, not a payment, not a fifth held change, not a rule, no payer standing (T036/T076/T006 held). Jorra at the shed's edge parts dusty forearms from clean as clot from vessel, meal-fine grey dust past the bent finger and white in a fist-crease and not bone-coloured slip; men unnamed go low into the back room before first grey and the room is not said cold; he speaks to the wheel before any person (It doesn't care whose hands. It cares if they're steady) and tells a pot You'll do; knows the full note three turns ahead with air under it and a want in it and withholds it from a High Kiln master who would call it early and make a song of it; puts his bent finger into the cold damper ahead of Sella's unfinished sentence so the end of it arrives at the pot; one piece of iron with two bites and no Grathic word for both mercies; he's not Vail stays sealed and the promise of the boy's name to the men who burn slates is neither given nor withdrawn; burned slate at five with a finger between the fifth and the four (T035/T031/T062/T065/T095). Garl stays in objects: salt-stiff coat with the left-shoulder crease, hollow wheel-seat, clean dark line and finer grey unswept, twice-mended pot with both proverbs gone to pot and fire and never to a person, tile debt uncalled, name unspoken 327 days. Sella carries him up at the going of the light, half-pace, fold righted without a look at his face, thread left, never the Debt Loft; a sound from above and behind only, no interior entered. Fire four and a gap, boards four four and a knot, river water over water — three counts that do not become one. Answer 230 at the close: small intake let go whole on the river's note, the note had done before the hand came down so neither early again nor stayed.

scenes.title: The Twenty-Ninth Morning
scenes.synopsis: Third entry and second dated \daymark{328}{Bone 29, Ninthday, Y.H. 813}: the small hours under the Vail kiln-house roof into the first light of an ordinary Ninthday with no market, Cross or bell. New day, new date, no recap; nothing from Bone 28 comes in as sign, lesson, mending, cause or payment; no handful and no thumb's resting. Carry 327 to 328 exact, six months and 148 days told by nobody (T071/T072); the carried fire's fifth unpaid 328 days, payer unnamed (T088); Garl's name unspoken the same number (T009/T013/T092). Bone 30 (Day 329), the month's third and last reading, one morning ahead and not brought into a day that has not earned it. Body inventory renewed in the surgeon's old order: crust, unnamed gap, thread, cold, the waiting afterdrop; the composed face that is not composure; the infant's want louder than the surgeon's knowing, both true, neither winning, the argument the work (T060/T086). Hearth grammar intact: fire before basket, coals told the thaw and turned with the back of a broken pot, The house will keep it, intake-hold-and-letting-go toward no opening with neither gap figured, finger on top of the loaf shelf so the charcoal stays unread, lips along a two-gapped row unfigured, one glance at the clay jar with the hand half over nothing and the little-door burn closing on air, twice-mended pot lifted on the thumb at the wire with both proverbs to pot and fire and the crack showing, dressed grain turned under wool with the lighter touch and no figure and no handful lifted, pot rim two inches beyond the reaching hand with a half-beat and no look toward the bed, widow's mark untouched at a morning and a hearth (T058/T079/T100, T077). Three counts in three places that do not become one; six hearings beside and never among with the seventh place empty; heard bell in its square beside the told; told figure beside the paid. File open on the towel with every gap gap; staying and early letting-go two objects with a finger between and neither repeated; handful one object and not repeated; thumb's resting one object and not repeated; four held changes on four places and not a rule; 230 honest answers on the sixth at the opening and 231 entered here. Five arithmetics ride locked in Berr's box with one in twelve unchallenged, figure read not figure paid, no signature, five readings five and not one account; finding on a place of its own with no payer and not laid across the not-doings, covered grain, four held changes, handful, thumb's resting, two small objects or his gaps — edges nearly touch, finger goes between (T015/T041/T047). The reading is tomorrow and is not brought in. Answer 231: hand up an inch, small intake, interval held whole, let go on the same low note, straight down.

scenes.title: The Last Tending Before the Reading
scenes.synopsis: Fourth entry, no new dated heading: the afternoon of Bone 29 through the going of the light and the small hours at the Clay Yard, the yard well and flat stone, rack end, kindling, flagstones, wheel-shed edge and damper, bed, boards and towel. Present: Corin/Dan, Sella, Tarn, Jorra, Ilva; a woman at the well; Garl in objects; no market, no Cross, no bell. Sella carries him at the half-pace and goes wide around the seven walked-around places with a look and a wide step and no number; the three coverings stay weather entered nowhere with a finger between every pair and no fourth likeness made a cause; the dressed grain lies turned under wool and given no figure (T009/T013/T092, T098 carried, T083/T085 held, T077). At the yard well Ilva draws with the pail against her knee, the rope stiff in the dry cold giving its small dry rasp as the bucket comes up, clay dried pale in the crescents of her nails and the finer grey rack dust worked into the seam of one thumb she does not scrub out; her hands know the weight of a pail and the edge of a wet board and have never been soft. A woman asks what the firings of Bone have taken. Ilva's hand goes toward her sleeve and stays; the short strip of notched birch bark, pale where a thumb has rubbed the notches and dark in the uncut grain between, is not taken out, read, copied, counted or joined to the charcoal under the loaf shelf, the cord, the open slate a pace away, the knot-string or the ownerless saying, and no figure comes off the wood. Her eyes go to the asker and her mouth opens after both with a half-beat between, and she answers the question put and not the one behind it: Ask the pot what it cost. I keep the count, not the account. She puts the flat of her hand once more on the sleeve and goes back to the pail, and nobody turns twice (T080 advanced, not paid). The boy takes the order of reaching apart as a chart is taken apart and files no tenth hand: Ilva's ninth stays nine on its own place with a finger between it and Hessa Rale's eighth; she is not made a reader of her own keeping; she is not Marra, the soft-handed man, the soft-cuffed clerk, Hessa, the green-mouthed woman at the pot board or the Drawing collector, and is joined to none. Hunts and repairs stay directions: a cost asked as a direction is answered with the weather, the pot and the river and leaves no entry (T077). Jorra's men unnamed come low before first grey and get no name; he parts dusty forearms from clean, speaks to the wheel and a pot before any person, withholds the full note known three turns ahead, and puts his bent finger into the cold damper ahead of Sella's unfinished sentence; one iron with two bites and no Grathic word for both mercies (T035/T031/T062). The holding tray is checked unchanged: burned slate five with no sixth, no witness and no hand at the flame; row five askings with one shaping and no witness and expressly no sixth; well-saying three shapings with Hessa's eighth hand on its own place and a finger between; shut-room tellings two; three pot sayings with the Smoke 14 note standing apart; nine record-first hands with Ilva's ninth unread in its sleeve and no tenth, the wood keeping its count where no slate can take a figure off it; nine stoppings with no tenth before the seventh year at its very end and the loan uncalled; six hearings beside and never among with the seventh place empty, the sixth the small flat knock out of a woman as the men lifted her, filed where a thing out of a person must go; five openings in five months with the sixth far off at Ash 2 (Day 331); seven green a colour and seven shape a shape with no eighth; the heard bell in its square beside the told; no collector up or down the clay road (T101, T080, T035/T031/T065/T095, T061/T082, T036/T076, T006, T078, T050/T051, T033/T034, T058/T079). Tarn at the kindling keeps six and the seventh and the thumb's resting stays one object not made again (T036/T076/T006 held). Garl in objects, name unspoken 328 days, tile debt uncalled. Sella carries him up at the going of the light, half-pace, fold righted without a look at his face, thread left, never the Debt Loft. Answer 232 at the close: small intake let go whole on the river's note, neither stayed nor early; the thumb drawn back to the six where the house can check, the knife at the edge of its sill with the seventh uncut and the unforged sentence beside it, Bone 30 one morning ahead.

scenes.title: The Third Reading
scenes.synopsis: Fifth entry and third dated \daymark{329}{Bone 30, Tenthday, Y.H. 813}: the small hours under the Vail kiln-house roof into Bone's third and last Account-day and market, earned by its own morning, at the Cross — the reading block under the moot-post, the moot-post's finger's width of shade, the pot board, the out-of-line landing below the north bridge, the clay road up toward High Kiln and on to Greybank. Present: Corin/Dan, Sella, Berr Clay, Hessa Rale; walk-ons (the soft-cuffed clerk at the landing, the green-mouthed woman at the pot board, the foundling at the market's edge, the crowd of goers-by); Garl in objects. No Ilva (offstage on Bone 30). New day, new date, no recap; nothing from Bone 28 or 29 crosses as sign, lesson, mending, cause or payment; the handful and the thumb's resting are not made again. Carry 328 to 329 exact, six months and 149 days told by nobody (T071/T072); the carried fire's fifth unpaid 329 days, payer unnamed (T088); Garl's name unspoken the same (T009/T013/T092). Bone goes out without a boundary drawn and neither of the district's two habits of naming its months is corrected. Body inventory renewed in the surgeon's old order; surgeon versus infant quarrel, both true, the second louder, the argument the work (T060/T086). Sella carries him down at the half-pace from every open slate, sets the basket in the moot-post's finger's width of shade where no slate lay, stands half a pace off through the reading and the bell, gives the instruction to the wool and the river wind and never to the basket (T058/T079). THE CHAPTER'S ONE MEANINGFUL CHANGE, ADVANCED AND NOT PAID (T015/T041/T047): Berr comes up short off the clay road with the red wool cord of his office folded square under his coat and the sweetish green of tasted lead glaze at one mouth-corner, under the hot clay of him the smell of nothing at all; his hands are large and clean and he wipes his thumb twice on his apron before touching nothing, once for the slate and once for the figure that would be on it; he holds a narrow slate unopened against his forearm with the writing inward, passes a finger over the figure and lets his eyes rest on the writing a breath longer than the writing required; reads One in twelve, as the notice says low into the two hundred and sends the figure twice over the basket, once for the moot and once for the late households; calls the levy and denies it with The levy is called. It is not called by me and your house, never I, taking himself out of his own sentence as a surgeon takes a hand out of a field before the dressing goes on; says something low to the block about kindness being entered; goes off up the clay road with the cord folded, the narrow slate under his arm and the box locked, Bone's third true subtraction riding inside beside the other five, believing he has done a kindness. SIX ARITHMETICS OF THE YEAR NOW STAND BEHIND ONE PRINTED FIGURE: one in twelve unchallenged, the figure read still not the figure paid, no signature on the space, six readings six and not one account; a rule made from six would want a payer put under all six and none stands. The boy keeps the finding on a place of its own with no payer, not a lesson, grievance, mending, doctrine or rule, and does not lay it across the house's not-doings, the covered grain, the four held changes, the handful, the thumb's resting, the two small objects of the hand or his own gaps — the edges nearly touch and the finger goes between. The reading answers nothing for the hand that went in on Seed 15, the man carried out on Day 188, the dressed grain read over by a number that did not know its cost, or the carried fire's missing fifth. Hessa takes the narrow slate up the road toward Greybank before noon, edge-on to her forearm with the writing turned to her sleeve, her hand to the slate before her eyes to the crowd, answering the women at the rail I don't read it. I carry it. There's a difference, and the road doesn't care which and Cross to Greybank. Reading goes up before noon. I've got a road to walk; her eighth hand stays eighth on its own place, no figure comes off the slate, no fourth shaping is made and she is not made a reader (T080 advanced, not paid). The bell goes four, four and a gap, heard beside told and not made a seventh, nobody crossing himself (T078). The soft-cuffed clerk stays set at the out-of-line landing for an uncalled measure (T090 held). The green-mouthed woman at the pot board and the foundling at the market's edge are sightings only, a seventh of each with no eighth, never called Fenna or Ulda in the narration, no loaf, slate, sale, hearing or romance (T050/T051, T033/T034 held). Answer 233 in the moot-post's shade: hand up an inch, small intake from the room whose floor does not touch his, interval held whole, let go on the river's note, straight down; the note had done before the hand came down, so neither early again nor stayed, borrowing no house count and supplying no payer (T061/T082). Close on Berr going up the clay road with the cord folded, the slate under his arm and the box locked, six true subtractions riding inside under one unsigned figure, and Sella standing half a pace off in the moot-post's shade with the basket where no slate lay.

scenes.title: The Month Goes Out
scenes.synopsis: Sixth and final entry, chapter close, no new dated heading: Day 329, Bone 30, the going of the light and the small hours at the Clay Yard, the yard well and flat stone, rack end, kindling, flagstones, wheel-shed edge and damper, bed, boards and towel. Present: Corin/Dan, Sella, Tarn, Jorra; walk-ons (Cold Acre hare-carrier, cracked-jar man, woman with a basket of kindling, two men arguing the thaw); Garl in objects. No Ilva, no Berr, no Hessa, no clerk, no green or shape at the close; no collector. Bone goes out without a boundary drawn and neither of the district's two habits of naming its months is corrected; the yard goes around its seven walked-around places with a look and a wide step and no number; the month's hunts and repairs stay directions judged by the arm and the weather, never figures; the three coverings stay weather entered nowhere with a finger between every pair (T009/T013/T092, T098 carried, T083/T085, T077). Hunts and repairs as directions: a man down from Cold Acre answers the price of his hare with the weather; a man with a cracked jar in a rope sling is told to ask the pot and the pot says nothing; a woman with a basket of kindling asks what the seventh year will want when it comes and two men say the thaw will be early and late; Tarn says Yes, house to each and keeps the late because a late thaw puts off the paying, agreeing so thoroughly that no argument can find a foot; no collector comes up or down the clay road (T036/T076, T077). The chapter's held objects are checked and left on their own places: the thumb's resting on the seventh notch is one object, not made again on Bone 28, 29 or 30, not a tenth stopping, not the seventh year given, not a payment, not a fifth held change, not a hearing, not a mending and not a rule, with a finger between it and the nine stoppings, the four held changes, the handful and his own gaps — a touch that took nothing and paid nothing, kept because it was true and not because it bought anything (T036/T076/T006); the handful let fall at the rack end on Bone 22 stays one object and is not made again; the staying of Bone 15 and the early letting-go of Bone 17 stay two objects and are not made again; four held changes on four places and not a rule. Six arithmetics with their true subtractions ride locked in Berr's box toward High Kiln, one in twelve unchallenged, figure read not figure paid, no signature, six are six and not one account, the finding on a place of its own with no payer and not laid across the not-doings, the covered grain, the four held changes, the handful, the thumb's resting, the two small objects or his gaps — edges nearly touch, finger goes between; no doctrine stands up out of any of it, for a doctrine is an account that has found a payer and none stood (T015/T041/T047). The whole holding tray is checked unchanged: burned slate five with no sixth, no witness and no hand at the flame; row five askings with one shaping and no witness and expressly no sixth; well-saying three shapings with Hessa's eighth hand on its own place and a finger between; shut-room tellings two; three pot sayings with the Smoke 14 note apart; nine record-first hands with Ilva's ninth in a sleeve and no tenth, the wood keeping its count where no slate can take a figure off it; nine stoppings with no tenth before the seventh year at its very end and the loan uncalled; six hearings beside and never among with the seventh place empty, the sixth the small flat knock out of a woman as the men lifted her, filed where a thing out of a person must go; five openings in five months with the sixth far off at Ash 2 (Day 331) and not brought near; seven green a colour and seven shape a shape with no eighth; the heard bell in its square beside the told; no collector up or down the clay road (T080, T101, T035/T031/T065/T095, T061/T082, T036/T076, T006, T078, T050/T051, T033/T034, T058/T079). Garl in objects, name unspoken 329 days, tile debt uncalled, no lesson made. Jorra at the shed's edge and the damper: dusty forearms parted from clean, spoken to the wheel and a pot before any person, full note withheld, bent finger into the cold damper ahead of Sella's unfinished sentence, one iron with two bites and no Grathic word for both mercies, he's not Vail sealed and the promise neither given nor withdrawn (T035/T031/T062). Sella sets him on his bed under the roof at the going of the light, half-pace, fold righted without a look at his face, thread left, never the Debt Loft; a sound from above and behind only and no interior entered. Fire four and a gap, boards four four and a knot, river water over water — three counts in three places and none rises into another, because agreeing any two would want a payer put under both and none stands. At the very end of the day answer 234: hand up an inch, small intake from the room whose floor does not touch his, interval held whole, let go on the same low note, straight down and laid back against the fold as a man puts away a tool where the next hand will find it without looking; the note had done before the hand came down, so neither early again nor stayed; exact, complete, worth nothing at two inches of air, a restraint and not a payment, borrowing no house count and supplying no payer, laid across neither the six arithmetics, the bell's gap, the covered grain, the handful, the thumb's resting, the stayed object, the early letting-go nor his own gaps. TWO HUNDRED AND THIRTY-FOUR HONEST ANSWERS stand on the sixth, each an object and not a power, none a doctrine. Close on the count: 329 exact, complete, unspent, spoken by nobody; six months and 149 days told by nobody; the fire's fifth unpaid the same number with its payer unnamed; Garl's name unspoken the same; nothing opened, joined, named, called, paid or ended; the keeping of the number the only honest work there was to do, bought nothing, going on because attention is the one thing no institution can tax. Bone goes out without a boundary drawn; Ash 1 (Day 330) one morning ahead and Ash 2 (Day 331), the sixth opening, two mornings ahead, neither brought into a day that has not earned it (T071/T072, T088).
